notes: The sentence is about staying alive - hunger, thirst, predators and hostile players until death - so Survival leads, with Roleplay & Avatar Sim named second because you are an animal for the whole life. Resource Survival is the matching preset, but I swapped its world-biomes shape for wilderness-open, taken from the Roleplay file: the author asked for one huge shared map of natural land, water and air with no settlement and stated no distance-scaled difficulty, so the P4 split world-biomes implies is unwanted and wilderness-open describes players inhabiting terrain as creatures exactly. Dropped buildzone-plot since nothing is built, and kept collectible-nodes bent to the food and water spread around the map. Playable fish and birds on the same surface make water-body's swimming and flight envelope the one thing to verify, hence CHECK; I assumed without asking that there is no escape or finish because the run ends in death, so no gate-escape.
